name: vesma-cortex-gate-contract
authority: docs/specs/eval-methodology.md #6 (anti-HARKing: values are pinned there and in CI)
separation_rule: A PR that changes this file must not contain artifact changes, and vice versa (eval-methodology #6) — hence this file lives OUTSIDE models/vesma-cortex-v1/.

invariants.feature_contract: manifest feature order == ONNX metadata 'features' == cortex.features.pair.FEATURE_NAMES (frozen 13); feature_set_sha256 == digest of that order
invariants.typed_output: 100% typed verdicts: every response carries a valid Noul + Score

monotonicity.rule: P non-increasing as cosine drops over the fixed probe pair

near_boundary.metric: P(dup | light perturbation of the probe)
near_boundary.note: cut = the runner DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD_PROBABILITY; catches threshold-edge collapses, does not rank close revisions

verdicts.layer_b: ADOPT/DECLINE by the frozen prereg v2 decision rule (6 conditions); owner decision
verdicts.b0_delta_rate: field-value criterion, not an artifact-quality gate

probes.source: src/cortex/eval/sanity.py — PROBE_RECORD / UNRELATED_RECORD (frozen synthetic content; no store, no network; deterministic)
probes.runner: scripts/eval_sanity_suite.py --bundle <dir-or-model.onnx> — exit code != 0 means FAIL, no ADOPT on a red suite
probes.pairs_computed_via: cortex.features.pair.features only (#480 lesson: local feature-math copies drift from the production wrapper)
probe_classes_tails: translated twins (in ds1000 synth, not in the suite)
probes.note: coverage table per eval-methodology #7; tails are known blind spots, kept visible, not silent

change_control: Thresholds change only by a pre-registered addendum BEFORE the eval run; raising a merge-gate threshold requires an owner directive (ADR 0003, 'Позиции и споры'; engine ADR-0026 precedent). Layer B re-export exception: unchanged weights_sha256 -> 1e-6 output equivalence on the frozen set instead of burning the holdout (eval-methodology #6).
